name: Hand-drawn Illustration
visualIdentity: Explicit hand-drawn illustration style in the Drawing and Illustration category. Preserve pressure variation, drawing speed, and small linework irregularities, with limited color fills, subtle paper texture, and consistent character proportions. A hand-drawn look alone does not mean each frame was drawn; frame-by-frame drawing or layered artwork movement must be chosen explicitly.
suitableUses: Explicit: the source names narrative or warm brand pieces as suitable when used alone. Explicit guidance: add a supporting style when held drawings feel static or the art needs explanatory labels. Other topics are inferred suitability, not stated. Unspecified: target durations, audiences, and platforms.
limitations: Random jitter does not create a hand-drawn style. Rough.js does not provide animation, handwriting, pressure-sensitive brushes, paper texture, or character poses. Hachure fills do not imitate pencil, ink-wash, halftone, or print media. Generated path order is not an authored drawing sequence. The source specifies no other limitations.
palette: Suggested, not approved: use only when no task, brand, or reference palette is supplied. Tokens: background #F7EFDF (warm paper), foreground #343E42 (drawn ink), accent_1 #BC705A, accent_2 #758D72. Four discrete colors with no gradient. Foreground on background measures 9.597:1. Paper-colored text on accent fills measures 3.278 and 3.162, below the 4.5 target, so accents are decorative only. Recheck composited frames.
motionAndInteraction: Motion must come from real frame-by-frame drawing or layered artwork movement, not random jitter. Shared guidance favors smooth, coherent movement where it helps, while preserving deliberate cuts, impacts, constant-speed sections, and reading holds. No interaction is specified; hover or scroll behavior applies only to interactive delivery, not video export. Optional motion references are gaze-following (requires eye layers or a rig), chaptered transitions, and scrollytelling; each needs scene fit.
audio: The source sets no required audio and explicitly avoids fixed genre, tempo, instrument, voice, or mandatory layers. Options per task include background music, voiceover, sung vocals, sound effects, ambience, or silence. Honor user audio choices and supplied assets first. No audio assets are supplied. Narration must stay intelligible without competing music or vocals; this is inferred guidance.
assetRequirements: Use pressure-sensitive brushes or authentic drawn assets. Layered artwork needs separated, named layers; character animation needs eye layers or a rig. Frame sequences should be transparent PNGs with alpha, consistent dimensions, and clear naming, inspected before composition. Fonts and assets must be loaded before rendering. The source specifies no resolution, count, or file format beyond these; missing assets must be reported.
combinations: Explicit recommendations: style-092 for holds using two or three line-variant boil cycles, with fills kept at #BC705A and #758D72 and only lines boiling on a stable cadence. style-024 for handwritten labels in #343E42 with #BC705A underlines, and arrows matching the brush. Avoid procedural noise boil, boiling text, mismatched cadences, digital-looking arrows, and a third accent color.
productionApproach: HyperFrames is primary for composition, timing, sync, validation, and export. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists, and the reason must be recorded. Visual construction uses Canvas 2D, PixiJS, Rough.js for sketch contours, p5.js, or Paper.js, selected by fidelity. Drive all state from shared composition time. Verify direct and out-of-order seeks, decoded frames, palette, and audio sync before delivery.
